Name: CP - Shane's Seasonal Coop Retexture
Author: ENGloomy
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]⛄ Replace Shane's coop in spouse outside area with a cute seasonal redesign.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vZdCwFKT/coop1.gif[/img][/size]
[size=4][b]Installation & Usage:[/b][/size]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffd966](Required)[/color] Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6b6b6](Optional)[/color] Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ - toggle texture on/off[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Retexture for Buildable Shane's Coop
[/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sexynes]Sexynes[/url] kindly granted me permission to make a retexture for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28915]Shane's Coop[/url].
With that mod, you can build Shane's Coop [color=#ffd966]anywhere in your farm[/color]! Besides, it's a [color=#ffd966]functinal coop[/color]. Amazing work!
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]Installation guide:
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28915]Shane's Coop[/url]﻿ and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]That's all. The Content Patcher will automatically apply the retexture.[/font]
[/list]Many thanks to sexynes for the coding!!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hPhtQx4T/door.gif[/img]
